designationHistory.indexText: Congress provided for Coltsville National Historical Park in Hartford, to be established once the Secretary of the Interior finds that required land and space donations are in place.
designationHistory.note: Sec. 3032(b)(2) delays establishment until the Secretary makes a determination and publishes notice in the Federal Register. A search of the Federal Register API for 'Coltsville' (Nov. 2026) found no notice of establishment.

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016 (p. 116), 'Authorized Dec. 19, 2014'
